description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment of Mr. C. D. Wickramaratne as the Inspector General of Police
categorisation: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Chandana Deepal Wickramaratne) to a government position (Inspector General of Police). It names the person and provides his basic title but does not include any detailed descriptions of his portfolio responsibilities, duties, or subject matter areas he will oversee. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
